description: Zero-dependency CLI and MCP server for AI video and talking-avatar generation, live model discovery, dry-run credit quoting, and PAYG cost estimation.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http aichili https://aichili.ai/mcp

notes: Read-only discovery and cost estimation tools (platform_overview, list_video_models, estimate_video_cost) require no authentication.
Wallet balance, dry-run quote planning, and video generation tools require a chili_sk_* Bearer API key (AICHILI_API_KEY).
